data.description:
## Context / Problem
The debug skill reads prior tickets but never writes back (reads from a well it never fills); Step 7 sweeps by construct only (parity siblings are ABSENCES invisible to grep); Reporting lets residual fragility evaporate. Approved changes 14+15+16 from the bug-trend review.

## Approach
(14) Writebacks: Phase-1-exit RCA comment (root cause + discriminating evidence); Reporting summary comment (cause/proof/test/fix/siblings/replication); not-a-bug classification comment + cited source; Step-7 siblings filed via create + discovered_from encoded DIRECTLY in the skill (no AGENTS.md reference — client projects may lack it). Approval-gate reconciliation: the project's own mandated tracker gets prescribed writebacks; third-party trackers stay approval-gated. (15) Step 7 second sweep axis (construct search unchanged), decomposed into 4 forced-artifact questions: NAME THE RULE (operation+property, must not name the fixed site); CHANNEL CENSUS (fixed 5-slot checklist: CLI / MCP-API / library-facade / automated-callers / dual-direction, plus caller-set derivation — a surface absent from the shared core's callers is the parity signature); PER-SURFACE PROBE (cite path:line or MISSING); DISPOSITION (RED-test fix or ticket + discovered_from). Trigger: only when fixed code sits on one of several parallel surfaces. (16) Reporting item 'Residual risk & prevention': per observed-with-citation fragility, forced disposition — ticket filed (may propose structural guard) / accepted with reason / fixed in scope; 'none observed' legitimate; prose only, no new ticket-system structures.

## Scope
- examples/agent-skills/rebar-debug/SKILL.md (+ symlinked copy consistency; ~35-45 lines total)

## Testing
Prose-only skill change: no code tests. Validation = skill-file lint/sync checks if present, and a dry-run read-through against the 4-question artifacts on one historical bug (4b59 link-direction class).

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] All four writebacks encoded at their lifecycle points with the tracker-vs-third-party gate distinction.
- [ ] Step 7 carries both axes with the 4-question decomposition and forced artifacts.
- [ ] Reporting carries the residual-risk disposition item with 'none observed' legitimate.
- [ ] No references to AGENTS.md; discovered_from linkage stated inline.
data.title: rebar-debug skill: ticket writebacks, two-axis Step-7 sweep, residual-risk disposition
